pr_title: Bluetooth Audio: Add codec parsing functions
pr_body:
Fixes #42960.
Introduce functions to parse codec configuration and use them for LC3 configuration for BAP unicast applications.
pr_comments: @Thalley Thanks for the thorough review! I'll look through this PR to check I got all of it addressed and check all the checks pass.

issue_context.title: Bluetooth: Audio: Codec config parsing and documentation
issue_context.body:
**Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe.**
The current code includes all the functionality needed to define and select a codec configuration, but there is nothing to parse the codec config data to actually use the parameters configured to configure a codec implementation.

**Describe the solution you'd like**
It would be nice with utility functions to extract the data from the codec configuration data structure to pass it to a codec implementation.

**Describe alternatives you've considered**
The specification defines codec configuration data as a binary blob of data. The alternative to adding parsing into the stack would be to add parsing into the codec implementation to have it "understand" this binary blob of data.
But as the format of this is defined in the Bluetooth standard for LC3 this approach do not seem right.
Also the Bluetooth specification defines error codes the stack needs to return in case it detects invalid values configured.

**Additional context**
Currently all the assigned number values for codec configuration is located under LC3 in lc3.h. This is wrong as these assigned numbers are generic for all codecs that would like to use them - hence should be moved to audio.h.
Also the documentation of the codec configuration is missing the generated documentation, and as this feature request will result in new API documentation it should be fixed as part of this issue.
